subject: A typo in user manual 2.9.0 (GP Modeling)

messages.author: 3b679b7acf28007c
messages.subject: A typo in user manual 2.9.0 (GP Modeling)
parts:
Hi,
As I'm reading chp. 15 of the user manual (Gaussian-Processes), I noticed a typo on page 167. Under "Cholesky Factorization Speedup", you mentioned using Cholesky factorization under the "transformed data" block. As the model includes parameters and Sigma is not properly defined until the "model" block, I guess we should use Cholesky factorization under the "model" block and NOT the "transformed data".

Thanks,
-Sepehr
